change.task: Review finding 7 of PR #859: keep the owner-stop failure record when the residual stop also fails
change.driver: At the end of a segment, the residual-stop failure path appends its line to writer-stop-failure.txt. Before, it replaced the file and lost the owner-stop failure record that the driver wrote a few lines earlier. This is the only change to the driver since the accepted bytes of PR #870.
change.diff: printf 'Residual writer termination under .subprocess-data is unconfirmed at the end of the segment.\n' >"$OUTPUT_DIR/writer-stop-failure.txt" becomes the same line with >>

guarantee_change.before: When the owner stop and the residual stop both fail in one segment, writer-stop-failure.txt keeps only the residual-stop line.
guarantee_change.after: When both stops fail, writer-stop-failure.txt keeps the owner-stop record, its timeout line, and its docker output, followed by the residual-stop line.
guarantee_change.unchanged: The stop decisions, the failure count, the early-exit reason, and the four limitations of the PR #870 acceptance do not change.
